Q1: Disodium carbonate sesquiperoxide has internationally recognized significant hazards (Tier 1) for oral and dermal/eye exposure based on the GHS. More current data indicate potential inhalation hazards (Tier 2). Environmental hazards are considered low to moderate (Tier 3), but several hazard categories—carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive hazards, endocrine disruption, and organ/systemic toxicity—currently lack sufficient data for a confident assessment (Tier 4).
